limits: Every baseline cold index exited 132 before query evidence. Baseline quality is UNRESOLVED, never zero recall.
Candidate indexing exited 1 with explicit partial syntax-graph receipts; SCIP tooling is unavailable in the intentionally offline sandbox.
IceCouncil quality comes from eight anchored files, not the full repository. Its full-source attempt is retained separately.
Command failure durations are observations, not successful cold-index samples or speedups.
Overall precision remains null; observed unlabelled edges are unadjudicated.
One host, fixed baseline-first order, one cold attempt per fixture; no OS page-cache flush or statistical performance claim.
RSS is unmeasured (GNU time unavailable). Embeddings were not indexed; identical model assets were supplied only for probes.
Anonymous test-callback ownership, full compiler enrichment, semantic-search quality and agent differential are unaccepted/unrun.
Raw logs and unreviewed observed names stay in operator-owned artifact storage; this summary is intentionally lossy.
